newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Matahari says stock split approved.
newsitem.headline: Matahari says stock split approved.

text.p: Indonesian retailer PT Matahari Putra Prima said on Monday it had won shareholder approval to pay a 1996 dividend of 15 rupiah per share and split the nominal value of its stock.
The company also announced that first quarter net profit was 41.3 billion rupiah, sharply higher than the 21.8 billion rupiah in same 1996 period.

Matahari president commissioner Hari Darmawan told the shareholders meeting that the decision to split the nominal value of the stock to 500 rupiah from the current 1,000 rupiah was designed at boosting liquidity.
"The management believes that this is the best time to split the stock," Darmawan said.
Matahari closed at 4,450 rupiah, a gain of 125 rupiah, on Monday with 461,000 shares changing hands.
